test_cases.test_case_title: Enroll a Registered Student in a Course
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with a pre-provisioned account is logged in and redirected to the Dashboard Page. A course, 'Introduction to Software Engineering', has been created and is accessible from the Dashboard. A registered student with the email 'student_newuser@example.com' exists in the system but is not yet enrolled in the course.
test_cases.expected_result: The system successfully enrolls the student 'student_newuser@example.com' into the course. The student list for the course is updated to display the newly enrolled student.
test_cases.post_condition: The registered student 'student_newuser@example.com' is successfully enrolled in the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course, and the updated student list is displayed on the 'Students' tab of the Course Details Page.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course in the 'Course List' to navigate to the Course Details Page.
Click the 'Students' tab to view student management options.
Click the 'Add Student Button' to open the 'Add new attenders' modal.
Enter 'student_newuser@example.com' into the 'Email Input' field.
test_steps.screen: 2.1.1.5.5.1 Add New Attenders Modal (from Students Tab)

test_steps.step: Click the 'Send Button' to add the student.

test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher attempts to enroll an already enrolled student via Add Single Student
test_cases.pre_condition: A teacher is logged into the FullTeaching platform with a pre-provisioned account. A course named 'Introduction to Software Engineering' exists on the dashboard. A student with the email 'already_enrolled_email' is already enrolled in this course.
test_cases.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that the student is already enrolled, and the student list for the course should remain unchanged. The Teacher remains on the add student form.
test_cases.post_condition: The teacher is still on the course details page, specifically on the 'Students' tab, with the add student form displayed, and an error message is visible.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Course List item (link)' for 'Introduction to Software Engineering' to navigate to the Course Details Page.
Click the 'Students' tab to open the student management view.
Click the 'Add Student Button' to open the 'Add New Attenders Modal'.
Enter 'already_enrolled_email' into the 'Email Input' field.
Click the 'Send Button' to add the student.

test_cases.test_case_title: Enroll an unregistered student in a course via single student add
test_cases.pre_condition: A teacher with an existing account is logged in and has navigated to the dashboard. A course (e.g., 'Introduction to Software Engineering') has been created by the teacher. The teacher is currently on the 'Course Details Page' for that course, on the 'Students' tab.
test_cases.expected_result: The system should report a failure to enroll the student due to the email address not being associated with a registered user. The student list should remain unchanged, and an error message indicating the user is unregistered should be displayed.
test_cases.post_condition: The teacher remains on the 'Add New Attenders Modal', and the student list for the course remains unchanged.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Course List item (link)' for 'Introduction to Software Engineering' to navigate to its details page.
Click the 'Students' tab to view the student management section.
Click the 'Add Student Button' to open the 'Add new attenders' modal.
Enter 'unregistered@example.com' into the 'Email Input' field.
